item.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Wedding Was Officiated by Adam Sandler
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dish out the latest entertainment news. Today, we've got a romantic update for you: Taylor Swift is off the market! She just tied the knot with NFL star Travis Kelce in a star-studded ceremony at Madison Square Garden in New York City.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: The ceremony was led by none other than comedian Adam Sandler, who officiated the exchange of vows. Taylor's brother, Austin, was her man of honor, while Travis had his brother Jason by his side as best man. As for the wedding looks, we know that Taylor and Travis collaborated with Jonathan Anderson, the creative director of Dior, to design their custom outfits. They also wore Christian Louboutins, and Taylor sparkled in Cartier.
[Music transitions to a more upbeat tune]
Host: The wedding was attended by A-list friends, including Jack Antonoff, Mariska Hargitay, Ed Sheeran, and Camila Cabello. And in a fun nod to their relationship, giant screens outside the venue flashed "JUST&T MARRIED!" after the couple said their "I dos". The proposal happened back in August 2025, with Travis popping the question to the 14-time Grammy winner.
[Outro music starts]
Host: That's all for today, folks. Congratulations to Taylor and Travis on their special day! We'll keep you posted on more updates from the world of entertainment. Thanks for tuning in!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
